data.title: bn-2og: M0.6.2 Run the contract fixtures through Investigation's shipped public interface
data.description: Investigation 0.1.0 at 612eadb706eb14f349bad3b5625e0e8577180fc2 passed 8/12 real fixture cases. Three Investigation packages track the gaps. The fixture adapter and provisional ADR preserve the failing acceptance and the bone remains doing. Full just check passed.

data.reason: LGTM for the provisional real-CLI adapter and ADR only, not for closing bn-2og. Independently reproduced 8/12 against Investigation 0.1.0; four failing cases map exactly to upstream bn-q7sy, bn-29y4 and bn-u6ja. Fixture self-test is 12/12, archived source matches 612eadb, full just check passed under host permissions. The binary version guard is 0.1.0 only, so the ADR's manual source-pin verification remains required.

LGTM for the synced provisional Investigation adapter and ADR only; bn-2og remains doing. The reviewed patch is byte-identical before and after replay (SHA-256 5fd6cbbf1d529a83088f6466f306db64a533fe200ebec8f83e6213180c53426d). Full just check passes on 796299f. Real Investigation 0.1.0 at 612eadb still reproduces 8/12: four failing cases map to bn-q7sy, bn-29y4, and bn-u6ja. Do not treat this approval as fixture acceptance or close the bone.
